One of the greatest character introductions in film history! 

Tom Cruise loved Boogie Nights (1997) so much that he contacted Paul Thomas Anderson while on the set of Stanley Kubrick's Eyes Wide Shut (1999), and asked him to consider him for a part in his next film Magnolia (1999). When Cruise was offered the part of Frank T.J. Mackey, he was initially rather terrified at playing such a controversial character, and needed some persuasion. However, he eventually relished the role as it was so completely different from the repressed character he played in Eyes Wide Shut. Such was his desire to work with Anderson that he agreed to a salary of only $100,000, a mere 0.5% of his usual $20 million fee.
